newsitem.title: FRANCE: French field peas development ahead of 1996 - UNIP.
newsitem.headline: French field peas development ahead of 1996 - UNIP.

text.p: France's field pea crop for 1997 is making good progress, with plant development now ahead of last year, industry group UNIP said on Friday.
In northern France peas sown in early March reached the "early blooming" stage between May 20 and May 25, 10 days ahead when compared to the situation in 1996, UNIP said in a routine report.
In the south, crop development was also well ahead of last year and grains should mature before end-June, it said.
Cumulative rainfall since April 20 reached between 70 mm and 120 mm, depending on regions, and was "more favourable than last year".
However, the regions that had received less rain might soon experience a moisture shortfall.
"The development of the plants and their health is satisfactory," UNIP concluded.
UNIP has predicted that 1997 field pea sowings may rise by 79,000 hectares over 1996 to around 615,000 ha.
